oneLine: Alphawave likely cashes out in ₹1,895 crore block deals in Lenskart Solutions.

sources.title: Lenskart Solutions shares fall 5% after ₹1,895 crore block deals; Alphawave likely seller

synopsis: Alpha Wave Ventures LP is likely the seller in a block deal involving Lenskart Solutions, where 2.93 crore shares or 1.67% equity worth ₹1,895 crore changed hands at ₹647 per share on Monday, October 12, 2026. Sources indicated Alpha Wave was likely to sell up to a 1.6% stake for up to ₹1,691 crore at a floor price of ₹640 per share, with an upsize option. Official buyers and sellers were not yet named at the time of the report, and sellers face a 30-day lock-in period for further stake sales. This follows previous block deals by major investors in recent months, including Alpha Wave's sale in August and Softbank Vision Fund II's offloading of shares.
